scope: 11 ordinary WorldMap destination loops; not narrative postplot chapter titles
rebuild: Normal caption build replays frozen source-guarded sparse per-frame PNG repairs, not a new neural inference. Frozen bytes govern repeatability; neural provenance records research/model production, not a promise of bit-identical re-inference on another GPU.
artistic_method: Per-clip complete source glyph-body/outline support, sparse temporal RGB reconstruction, copyback only owned pixels, native compass/fan pixels outside mask retained; native measured Chinese serif height/anchor and source-normalized colour rows. No flat-fill bar, widened text cover or harmonic RGB interpolation.
limits: Hidden original art is unknown. All-frame native bounded review and independent decode/audio checks are offline evidence, not game/user acceptance.
